messages:
Anna R.: starting rollout of model-quantize-v3 to eu-west-2 now — traffic shift 10% -> 50% over 15m. watch p95 and 5xx on embeddings route.
release-bot: Deploy started: release/model-quantize-v3 @ eu-west-2. change-window 23:00-01:00 UTC. progressing to 10% (10/100). :rocket:
Devon: thanks. hooking up the SLO dashboards now. which panel has the kv-cache miss rate?
Mike S.: embeddings/route p95 jumped to 480ms at t+4m, small 5xx bump (0.08% -> 0.25%). looks correlated with small batch sizes.
Priya: adding heatmap link: https://grafana.redwood/s/eu-west-2/rollouts?panel=embed_p95 — watch cpu and queue depth.
sre-bot: Alert (warn): embeddings-5xx-rate > 0.2% over 2m at 6789012352. Severity: warning. incident:INC-2026-482.
Anna R.: @Devon @Mike can we confirm it's transient? 10% traffic still. fallback target is model-quantize-v2 if it gets worse.
Devon: running a quick query: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{route="embeddings"} [2m]) * (status>=500)) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{route="embeddings"} [2m]))` — shows 0.26% now.
Mike S.: reproduced locally with a small sequence length distribution — KV cache misses spike with quantize-v3 at short sequences.
Priya: can we bump batching config for embeddings to reduce small-batch tail? suggestion: set `batch.max_delay_ms=8` for eu-west-2 workers.
Anna R.: apply patch to canary only? we don't want global change yet.
Devon: will patch canary config via `deploy-orch apply --env eu-west-2 --filter canary --set batch.max_delay_ms=8`
release-bot: Patch applied to canary. re-evaluating. traffic remains at 10%.
sre-bot: Note: new samples show 5xx rate dropped to 0.12% after config patch at 6789012358. p95 down to 260ms.
Mike S.: nice. hold at 10% for another 10m. if stable, continue to 50%.
Anna R.: agreed. leaving rollout paused for monitoring. please post any regressions to this thread. tagging @sre-bot for escalation rules if >0.5% 5xx. :thumbsup:
Devon: logging action items: 1) run perf job on short sequences for quantize-v3 2) add kvcache metrics to embed dashboard 3) prepare rollback note for quantize-v2.
Priya: I updated release notes with a short blurb about batching caveat and rollback steps: https://confluence.redwood/releases/quantize-v3
Mike S.: if we see another blip, we roll back to quantize-v2 and pin the model on Dedicated pools until follow-up.
Anna R.: thanks team. leaving this thread open. will call deploy complete after 50% looks stable for 20m.
